ModInfo.description:
Guarantees that no more than a single Bonus Tech (trashable Tech) is ever available for research. That way you can research them all, if you want to. Skipping them will be more comfortable too because all other Techs will be non-trashable Techs.
Tech Offer generation in detailed steps: 1.) If any trashable Techs are in Draw Pile, one of them gets selected. 2.) Then only non-trashable Techs get selected as long as there are such Techs in Draw Pile and the required number of Techs is not yet reached. 3.) If Draw Pile has no more non-trashable Techs but the required number of Techs has not been reached yet, all Techs get reshuffled (Discard Pile goes into Draw Pile). 4.) After reshuffle: If there has been no trashable Tech selected yet but there are such Techs available after reshuffle, one of them gets selected. 5.) Then again, only non-trashable Techs get selected as long as the required number of Techs is not yet reached.
Source is on github: https://github.com/FimbulvetrOW/OneBonus
Requires 0harmony mod for Harmony DLL
